hints.title: Cyclic Shift Characterization
hints.text: Each operation performs a non-zero cyclic shift of s by some offset from 1 to n - 1.

hints.title: Matching Shifts via Prefix Search
hints.text: Concatenate s with itself, slice off the last character to avoid full wrapping, and count occurrences of t using prefix function pattern search to find valid shift offsets.

hints.title: Recurrence for Transitions
hints.text: Closed form transitions count identity shifts dp[0] = ((n - 1)^k + (-1)^k * (n - 1)) / n and other shifts dp[1] = ((n - 1)^k - (-1)^k) / n modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: KMP search on concatenated string followed by modular exponentiation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating k matrix transitions or string rotations is far too slow for k = 10^15.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for KMP prefix function array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use KMP string matching and closed-form modular recurrence.
